versions: Session close/park semantics: v5 'close-keeps-record' → v9 added term_delete (true delete) → crucible-improve W6 (2026-06-30) redefined the panel × as graceful warm-park (STATUS_IDLE + capture_session_docs + summary hook) → 2026-07-08 transcript-snapshot warm-resume fix (merged 534bae1, DEPLOYED via the 2026-07-10 restart) = LATEST TRUTH.

Resume seeding: v6 restart-seed-from-summary → crucible-improve W3 (_build_continue_seed synthesizes a warm seed from on-disk docs for discovered/brownfield efforts) + W4 resume-as-session UI (2026-06-30) = LATEST TRUTH; the older summary-only seed description is superseded.

Cost capture: the job_runner stream-json envelope path (v2-era, refined through finalize_effort/attach_cost) is the ONLY capture path in every plan version v2→v12 and crucible-improve W1-W9 — no version ever added PTY-session cost capture; the v4 rollup's RUN-provenance-only rule is unchanged and consistent throughout (no conflict, but the gap has persisted across all versions).

Handoff/advance: v10 paste-NOT-submit + v11/v11.1 prepare_stage_handoff (persist-before-advance + transcript snapshot) supersede the v6 auto-advance description; v12 'Efforts' single-session model is BUILT but NOT merged — LATEST DEPLOYED TRUTH for advance semantics is v11.1 + crucible-improve waves on master.

items.fact: terminal_session.py launches the bare interactive engine on ConPTY via _resolve_engine_cmd (def at line 357; consumed by start_session at 487 and the switch path at 1003) and contains ZERO cost/usage capture — a fresh case-insensitive grep for cost|usage over the module (2026-07-11, this ingest) matches nothing but the _resolve_engine_cmd lines themselves.
items.label: Inferred

items.fact: effort_history.project_effort_rollup skips any session whose provenance != PROV_RUN (line 2282) and any is_discovered member (line 2288); cost blocks are written only by attach_cost (def line 2055) via finalize_effort (def 2448, call 2460) — i.e. only the job_runner finalize path ever attaches cost.
items.label: Confirmed
items.note: All cited line numbers re-verified by grep this run; the rollup's RUN-only / DISCOVERED→0 semantics are test-pinned (v4 healthcheck check_rnd_v4_surface rollup walk + effort_view rollup suite).

items.fact: job_runner captures usage from stream-json result envelopes (_parse_result_envelope def 808, consumed at 767; _cost_from_envelope def 833) and bridges cost onto efforts in _finalize (def 955, cost at 979) — and this path exists ONLY for job_runner.launch jobs, not PTY sessions.
items.label: Confirmed
items.note: Mechanism and line numbers re-verified by grep; the finalize/attach_cost bridge is exercised by the stubbed suites (fake_claude emits result envelopes). The doc's 'correct and complete' quality judgment is accepted as Confirmed only for mechanism+scope; no known counterexample. The PTY-exclusion half is confirmed jointly with diag-A1.

items.fact: persist_session_docs (effort_history.py, def line 2643) records every persisted PTY-session doc with source=SOURCE_DISCOVERED, status='imported', session_id tag and NO cost block (extras at 2724-2726; the parallel capture path at 3031-3033 does the same) — so every PTY-session effort is imported/discovered-provenance and, per diag-A2's skip logic, contributes 0 to the rollup.
items.label: Confirmed
items.note: Grep-verified this run; the persist path is STUB-GATE-tested (v8 keystone suites) and the discovered→0 rollup consequence is test-pinned. The tests pin the CURRENT behavior — they document the gap, they don't contradict it.

items.fact: The resume machinery inventory is real and live on master: _build_continue_seed + _synthesize_discovered_seed (crucible-improve W3), resume-as-session UI (W4), close_session warm-park STATUS_IDLE + capture_session_docs (W6), the summarize-on-finish hook (v7), and pending_paste/_flush_pending_paste paste-NOT-submit (v10) — all symbols present across terminal_session.py/anchor_gui.py/effort_history.py with dedicated test files (test_resume_backend_w3, test_resume_ui_w4, test_terminal_controls_w6, test_advance_paste_ui_v10, test_close_transcript_resume_2026_07).
items.label: Confirmed
items.note: Symbol presence re-verified by grep this run (142 occurrences across 20+ files incl. the named STUB-GATE test files); each wave was screenshot/Playwright signed off per project log. Note the 2026-07-08 transcript-snapshot warm-resume fix is merged AND deployed as of the 2026-07-10 restart.

items.fact: User-reported resume/tile inconsistencies (2026-07-11, unreproduced): some large tiles open a BLANK window; small tiles sometimes show a blue restart button with no context; the orientation/backup prompt must be manually executed after restart. Root causes unverified.
items.label: Gap
items.touchesCriterion: warm resume / session continuity reliability (directly bears on any 'resume opens warm, never blank' success criterion)
items.note: Resolvable by code-path investigation + Playwright repro against the live registry states (candidate suspects: seed synthesis returning empty for some record shapes; W6 parked-idle vs terminal status branching; the pending-paste flush gating on an unobserved greet). A concrete repro recipe from John (which project/tile/lane) would accelerate but is not strictly required — do NOT let planning assume a root cause before repro.

items.fact: There is NO mechanism anywhere in the codebase to capture cost/usage from interactive PTY sessions: bare interactive claude on ConPTY emits no stream-json result envelope, and nothing parses the engine's own session/usage records. The capture approach for interactive sessions is an OPEN DESIGN QUESTION (e.g. parse the engine's session JSONL/usage output, wrap the launch, or query a usage API), not merely an unwired existing path.
items.label: Gap
items.note: Derived from diag-A1+A3+A4 jointly — stated explicitly so planning doesn't silently assume the job_runner envelope path can be reused as-is for PTY sessions; it cannot without a design decision.

items.fact: Consequence: project_effort_rollup systematically UNDERCOUNTS real spend — every interactive-terminal (PTY) session's tokens/time/$ is invisible to the rollup, which now covers only one-shot job_runner lane launches, an increasingly small share of actual usage since v3 moved primary work into ConPTY sessions.
items.label: Inferred
items.note: Arithmetically forced by the Confirmed items A1/A2/A4, but the MAGNITUDE of undercount is unmeasured — no ground-truth spend comparison has been run.
